item.title: RateGain to Combine Sojern and Adara Under Single Brand — Exclusive
item.description: By folding Adara into Sojern, RateGain is putting both travel-planning data and its ad platform under one roof. The result: a unified company capable of linking booking data directly to the ads that drive them.

item.title: The AI Architects of Travel Take the Stage at Skift Data + AI Summit
item.description: Travel’s next growth cycle runs on data infrastructure, applied AI, and commercial precision. The executives building that future are taking the stage at Skift Data + AI Summit.

item.title: Tourism Fiji Launches First-Ever AI Travel Planner On Chinese TikTok
item.description: Can a destination turn a few seconds of interest into a concrete travel plan? Fiji’s AI Travel Planner is an early attempt to answer just that.

item.title: Indian Airlines Roll Out Middle East Flights for Stranded Travelers
item.description: As the situation in Iran and the Middle East remains uncertain, Indian airlines have taken on the responsibility for returning stranded passengers.

item.title: Why Ignoring Canada Just Got Expensive
item.description: Canada is in the middle of a quiet travel revolution, and most destinations are treating it like a rounding error. That is getting very expensive, very fast.

item.title: Travel Brands Are Building AI Agents for a Consumer That Doesn’t Exist
item.description: Travelers say they aren't ready to let AI book a trip. The industry is spending billions anyway — and no one has answered the most basic question: who pays when AI agents get it wrong?

item.title: Hyatt Sees Limited Impact From Mexico Violence, but Flags ‘Challenging Environment’ Globally
item.description: The bad news is that global uncertainty will dent hotel demand. The good news is that Hyatt can reroute guests to properties elsewhere.

item.title: Google Partners With Airline Systems to Track Lost Bags
item.description: Airlines used to control baggage tracking. Now passengers do. SITA is wiring that shift directly into the industry’s recovery system.

item.title: Expedia CFO: ‘We Radically Changed the Direction of the Company’
item.description: Expedia has been downsizing its workforce over the last year, and plowing some of the savings into machine learning and AI. It's a playbook that's taking place across industries.

item.title: Booking CFO: The AI Threat Isn’t ‘Really a Risk at All’
item.description: In the face of the LLM threat, Booking Holdings thinks it can repeatedly grow its top line 8% annually over the "medium term" and earnings per share 15% over the same timespan.
